plan.estimand: 3-level factor main effect in balanced 3-by-2 fixed factorial ANOVA
plan.hypothesis: H0: All levels of the 3-level factor have equal means; H1: At least one level mean differs
assumptions: Balanced design with equal cell sizes (n per cell)
All 6 cells are independent
Fixed factorial ANOVA with full interaction model
Common variance assumption (homogeneity of variance)
Null hypothesis: 3-level factor main effect with 2 numerator degrees of freedom
Effect size (partial eta-squared = 0.06) applies to the 3-level factor
Normality of residuals within cells
Rows and columns fully crossed
scientific_notes: Partial eta-squared = 0.06 is a small to medium effect in ANOVA contexts
The numerator df = 2 corresponds to the 3-level factor (number of levels minus 1)
Sample size calculation will invert the noncentral F distribution with parameters (2, error df, noncentrality λ) to achieve 80% power
Error df will depend on the per-cell sample size n and the full factorial design structure (df_error = 6n - 6)
The noncentrality parameter λ is derived from partial eta-squared and the error degrees of freedom
